g.title: SHIELD_I2C
g.text: CNC Shield v3 — SDA/SCL/5V/GND on its comms header (= R4 A4/A5, 5 V logic)
A4/A5 are the R4's primary I2C ('Wire'), 5 V logic. Four Dupont wires to the PCA9685 logic header. NOT the R4's Qwiic socket (that is Wire1, 3.3 V).

g.title: PCA_LOGIC
g.text: PCA9685 logic header (6 pins, either end)

Adafruit-pattern silkscreen: GND OE SCL SDA VCC V+. OE left open. VCC = 5 V from the shield, so the board's I2C pull-ups sit at 5 V — correct for the R4, and why this board must NOT also touch the Pi's SDA/SCL. Address 0x40.

g.title: XL4015
g.text: HiLetgo XL4015 5 A buck — trim OUT to 5.0 V

HiLetgo board: four big solder pads, IN+/IN− at the coil end, OUT+/OUT− at the other — tin them and solder the 22 AWG wires (no screw terminals). Set 5.00 V on the meter with nothing on OUT (pot turns counter-clockwise to lower). 4 A continuous, 5 A peak. OUT goes to the PCA9685 terminal, which distributes it to both servos and the fan. 5.0 V (not 6) so the fan can share this rail; the MG996R runs 4.8–7.2 V.

g.title: W_SERVO
g.text: 5.0 V rail: XL4015 OUT pads → the PCA9685 terminal

g.title: PCA_PWR
g.text: The big 2-pin terminal = the 5.0 V rail in from the XL4015. Every channel header's middle (V+) and bottom (GND) pin is bussed to it.

g.title: PCA_CH0
g.text: Rows: PWM (top), V+ (middle), GND (bottom). Tilt servo plugs straight on, brown/black to the GND row (as the Ceres turret was wired).

g.title: TILT
g.text: Plugs onto channel 0. Limits 65–150° in the firmware ('t 90'), Ceres mapping 600 + 10 µs/°.

g.title: PCA_CH2
g.text: Pan servo (continuous-rotation) plugs straight on, brown/black to the GND row (channel 2, as the Ceres sketch had it).

g.title: PAN
g.text: Plugs onto channel 2. It cannot hold an angle: the firmware only nudges it Ceres-style, 'n DIR MS' = 1250/1750 µs for 300 ms then pulse cut; 'p' stops.

g.title: PCA_CH15
g.text: PCA9685 channel 15 — used as a 5 V tap
Only V+ and GND are used: the fan's red to V+, black to GND. PWM pin stays empty.

g.title: FAN
g.text: 40 mm 5 V fan on the driver heatsinks
5 V 0.15 A (listing). Plugs onto channel 15's V+/GND pins.
